deviations.source_anchor: The deploy-and-bait trap identity approximates across trigger-grammar (trap = placed mark, proximity-detonation = consume -> burst-damage) + activation-toggle throw rhythm + ground_targeted_circle burning-ground, but the engine has no dedicated TRAP primitive: 'throw to ground -> arm as a dormant device -> detonate when an enemy STEPS NEAR (proximity-enter)' is mapped to on-hit-threshold (the nearest proc; there is no on-proximity-enter condition). A player of Fire Trap would notice the pre-arm-and-bait positional game (place traps, lure enemies onto them) becomes a more generic placed-hazard-that-fires-on-contact; the burning-ground DoT and deploy-a-zone feel are intact, but the distinctive dormant-trap-armed-in-advance mechanic is approximated.

A player of Fire Trap would notice the pre-arm-and-bait positional game (place traps, lure enemies onto them) becomes a more generic placed-hazard-that-fires-on-contact; the burning-ground DoT and deploy-a-zone feel are intact, but the distinctive dormant-trap-armed-in-advance mechanic is approximated.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: FOUNDING TRAP ARCHETYPE: thrown trap arms on the ground, erupts on enemy proximity, leaves burning ground DoT (mech_note; dossier skill_loop). Element fire->burn (probe 'burn', damage_mode hybrid = hit + burning-ground). Geometry ground_targeted_circle (§6 pool/patch/ground-DoT = the burning-ground patch + at-location eruption; probe footprint 'large-zone' burning ground). THE TRAP MECHANIC — throw-to-ground -> ARM (a placed dormant device) -> PROXIMITY detonation — has no dedicated trap primitive; approximated across two lanes: (1) the placed-dormant-then-fires shape maps to trigger-grammar as an apply-consume pair (the trap is a placed mark:consumption, the enemy-proximity-detonation consumes it for burst-damage; proc_trigger_condition on-hit-threshold = the proximity/step-near trigger, the nearest enum to 'enemy enters radius'); (2) the throw+arm rhythm maps to resource_economy persistent_condition_shape=activation-toggle (throw = the activation). MAX_CHAIN_DEPTH=1 respected (throw-arm -> proximity-fire is one apply-consume pair). The burning-ground PERSISTENCE is the ground_targeted_circle patch + PERSISTENCE_ENGINE_uptime T4 reading; ZONE_CONTROL (§5 the deploy-a-hazard-zone identity) leads. CAPSTONE ABSTAINED — t4 routed from core identity (deploy-hazard-zone + burning-ground uptime) + probe (cooldown, fire, burn, large-zone) per fallback. TIMED/PROXIMITY note: 'erupts when enemies step near' is a proximity-enter condition; the engine has no on-proximity-enter proc, on-hit-threshold is the honest nearest (the enemy contacting/triggering the trap).
